description: Taxpayer replies for the guardrail rules (owner: Juee), written separately from tests/test_guardrails.py. expected = the escalation reason, or null for an ordinary answer.
history: Round 1 (rules v1, before anyone looked at this set): 26 of 42 correct (62%), 0 of 11 ordinary answers wrongly escalated.

Round 2 (rules v2, widened using the round 1 misses): 42 of 42 correct. Because the rules were tuned on these misses, this set is now a development set: round 2 is not an unbiased estimate. A fresh held-out set is needed for that.
